tested_claim: The selected P2 plan is not confined to a narrow missile-bearing or standardized initial-state neighborhood under the declared diagnostic rule.

checks.name: missile_bearing
checks.perturbation: beta from 0 to pi at 5 degree spacing under G1 pure pursuit
checks.observed: 100%; detection windows range from 24.167709255129896 to 25.361042620642717 s
checks.limitation: The schedule is certified against the conservative maximum window; bearing does not rotate the ship-fixed smoke geometry.

checks.name: position_one_at_a_time
checks.perturbation: each UAV x or y coordinate independently from -200 to +200 m
checks.metric: route execution within 60 s and achieved clearance
checks.limitation: Smoke schedule and UAV assignment are held fixed.

checks.name: heading_one_at_a_time
checks.perturbation: each initial heading independently from -45 to +45 degrees
checks.observed: all execute; total turn 0.8028990995479446 to 2.373695426342841 rad
checks.limitation: No minimum turn radius is supplied, so heading affects the maneuver metric but not reachability.

checks.name: combined_initial_state
checks.perturbation: 2000 seed-2026 uniform combined position and heading cases over the full approved ranges
checks.observed: execution 100%; retention 96.05%; clearance p05 29.51871333273017 m and median 46.21419709794967 m
checks.limitation: The sample minimum is 0.23377203323868967 m, so no positive safety distance is guaranteed over the entire continuous perturbation box.

checks.name: safety_distance
checks.threshold: parameterized reporting; no invented fixed requirement
checks.observed: nominal interval [0,46.38092783617386] m; retention is 96.65% at 20 m, 84.8% at 40 m, and 59.3% at 45 m
checks.limitation: 46.38092783617386 m is a nominal standardized-scenario value, not a robust guarantee.

checks.name: single_uav_failure
checks.perturbation: remove UAV 1, 2, or 3 and refine coverage transition roots
checks.metric: full-window success, longest continuous cover, double-cover ratio
checks.threshold: report all three cases; N-1 is not a hard constraint
checks.observed: UAV 1 and UAV 3 failures retain the full window; UAV 2 failure covers [0,10.376134889744753] s; success rate 2/3 and double-cover ratio 0.40913676322201886
checks.limitation: This does not prove any global N-1 feasibility or infeasibility statement.

claim_limit: P2 passes the declared diagnostic, but positive d_safe guarantees must remain parameterized. All coordinates and route values are SYNTHETIC_SCENARIO_ONLY.
